raw.details:
About the Hackathon

INFRA SHIFT is an 8-hour offline AI hackathon bringing together developers, students, and working professionals to build innovative solutions using ML.ai, an AI-powered coding agent.

Organized by Infrasity in collaboration with Geek Room, the hackathon offers participants an opportunity to turn ideas into functional products, explore AI-assisted development, and connect with fellow builders.

The Challenge

Participants will work on real-world challenges involving AI, automation, business solutions, and emerging technologies.

Official problem statements will be revealed on 14 November 2026, at the hackathon venue.

An Open Innovation option will also be available, allowing teams to build solutions based on their own ideas.

Technology Partner - ML.ai

ML.ai is an AI-powered coding agent that helps developers plan, write, debug, and improve code, accelerating the journey from idea to working product.

Participants will use ML.ai as their primary AI coding agent during the hackathon.

We encourage all participants to explore the platform before the event and familiarise themselves with its capabilities.

Explore ML.ai: https://ml.ai/

Event Details

  • Date: 14 November 2026

  • Duration: 8 Hours

  • Venue: Infrasity Office, Janakpuri, New Delhi

  • Mode: Offline

  • Eligibility: Students & Working Professionals

  • Team Size: 1–4 Members

What to Expect

  • Real-world problem statements revealed on 14 November 2026

  • 1-Month Complimentary Access to ML.ai Infinite for all participants

  • No Token Limits to Worry About - build, experiment, and iterate without managing token budgets

  • Hands-on development with ML.ai, your AI-powered coding agent

  • Technical mentorship and guidance

  • An opportunity to build and demonstrate functional products

  • Networking with developers and industry professionals

Explore ML.ai, get familiar with its development environment, and bring your laptop, charger, and everything you need to build.

The challenges will be revealed on 14 November. The possibilities are yours to explore.

INFRA SHIFT

One Day. Eight Hours. Build Something That Matters.

prizes.others: ML.ai Infinite | 1-Month Complimentary Subscription.  All 100 participants will receive complimentary one-month access to ML.ai Infinite, an AI-powered coding agent, valued at ₹700 per participant.  Enjoy AI-assisted coding with no token-counting limits, subject to applicable fair-use policies. Build, experiment, and continue developing your projects beyond INFRA SHIFT.  Total Subscription Value: ₹70,000
